note: Seed hints for agent model selection. 'hint' answers 'what is this model for'. Structural facts are sourced, not typed. A capability is scoped to the endpoint it was established on: direct_api_verified=true means measured against the vendor's own API; false means declared by an aggregator or vendor docs and NOT yet confirmed on the direct endpoint. Operator text always wins over anything here.

deepseek/deepseek-flash.hint: cheapest near-frontier model; best default for bulk and mechanical agent work, and for wide fan-out where many agents run at once
deepseek/deepseek-flash.evidence: LLM Stats 51.8 at $0.24/M — lowest price in the near-frontier tier. Context 1,048,576 and max_tokens range [1,393216] measured directly against api.deepseek.com.

reasoning.note: reasoning_effort is SILENTLY IGNORED on the direct API (measured); OpenRouter declares support because it normalizes reasoning itself. thinking:disabled cut output from ~270 to 3 tokens but got test problems wrong.

deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro.hint: DeepSeek's strongest tier; use for hard multi-step or ambiguous work when flash is not enough but Codex is not warranted
deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro.evidence: LLM Stats 52.0 at $0.46/M, 57 tok/s. SWE-bench Verified 80.6% for the V4-Pro-Max variant — top open-weights score. Same 1,048,576 context, measured.

zai/glm-5.3.hint: near-frontier at low cost with the largest context here; good for long-context analysis and repo-wide reading, and it supports parallel tool calls
zai/glm-5.3.evidence: LLM Stats 52.7 at $1.33/M. Context 1,310,720. Declares parallel_tool_calls.

reasoning.note: GLM supports Preserved Thinking (clear_thinking:false) — reasoning_content from prior turns is fed BACK. Transcript policy must be 'preserve', unlike DeepSeek.

zai/glm-5.2.hint: previous GLM generation; solid balanced choice when 5.3 is unavailable
zai/glm-5.2.evidence: SWE-bench Pro 62.1%. Declares supported_efforts ['xhigh','high'] and parallel_tool_calls.

moonshot/kimi-k3.hint: strongest open-weights reasoning available; reach for it on the hardest analysis, at the highest cost and slowest speed of the open tier
moonshot/kimi-k3.evidence: Leads open-weights on LLM Stats at 53.0, GPQA 93.5%, but $3.39/M and 44 tok/s — the slowest and priciest here.

moonshot/kimi-k2.6.hint: strong coding model with parallel tool calls; good for mechanical multi-file edits

qwen/qwen3.8-max.hint: fastest of the top tier; use when throughput matters more than the last few points of capability
qwen/qwen3.8-max.evidence: LLM Stats 52.0 at 76 tok/s — fastest in the leading group — $1.81/M. Context 1,000,000.

reasoning.note: DashScope: reasoning.effort takes precedence over the legacy enable_thinking flag; the OpenAI-compat proxy maps reasoning_effort none/minimal->fast, low/medium->auto, high/xhigh/max->thinking.

qwen/qwen3.8-flash.hint: cheap high-throughput worker for simple lookups and mechanical work

xai/grok-4.6.hint: large context with a full effort ladder; good general-purpose alternative when you want effort control on a non-Codex model

xai/grok-4.3.hint: million-token context with a full effort ladder including 'none'; use for very long inputs

mistral/mistral-medium-3-5.hint: balanced European-hosted option with strict JSON-schema support; good when structured output matters
mistral/mistral-medium-3-5.evidence: Context 262,144, declares reasoning_effort. Mistral offers strict json_schema modes that DeepSeek does not.

mistral/devstral-2512.hint: code-specialised; use for mechanical code edits rather than open-ended reasoning

ollama/llama-3.3-70b.hint: solid local workhorse with native tool-calling templates; the default choice for self-hosted agent work
ollama/llama-3.3-70b.evidence: Context 131,072 served; real local window is set at server start (-c / --max-model-len / --context-length), so confirm it per install.

ollama/llama-4-scout.hint: very large context for a local model; use for long-document reading when you can afford the memory
ollama/llama-4-scout.evidence: Context 1,310,720 served upstream. Local window depends entirely on how the runtime was started.

ollama/qwen3.6-35b-a3b.hint: efficient MoE local model; good throughput per GB of VRAM for mechanical work
ollama/qwen3.6-35b-a3b.evidence: Context 262,144 upstream. MoE architecture keeps active parameters low.

ollama/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b.hint: small tool-calling local model for simple, high-volume steps

codex/gpt-6-astra.clause_hint: GPT-6 generation: the strongest reasoning tier, for the hardest multi-step work; rejects effort 'none'
codex/gpt-6-astra.property_hint: GPT-6 generation, the strongest reasoning tier, for the hardest multi-step work (rejects effort 'none')
codex/gpt-6-astra.note: verbatim from defs/agents.py — byte-identical parity required

codex/gpt-5.6-sol.property_hint: deepest 5.6 reasoning, best for hard multi-step or ambiguous work

codex/gpt-5.6-terra.property_hint: balanced, a solid default for most tasks
